close_reason: Superseded by audit 2026-05-11. RFC 5280 baseline checks (EKU at pkix-path/src/lib.rs:3091-3118, SAN presence at :3085-3088 and :3126-3134, nameConstraints, policyMappings, etc.) are integral to validate_path. Revocation loop at pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:172-181 is integral to verify_chain. Not separable as standalone policy objects.
description:
**`policies::rfc5280_baseline()`** — always-included implicit policy. Emits findings for any RFC 5280 §6.1 issue (validity period, name chaining, basicConstraints, key usage on intermediates, critical-extension recognition). May be a no-op wrapper if `verify()` already runs path validation in step 2 and surfaces those errors directly; this policy then serves as the rule-ID-tagged finding source.

**`policies::revocation(mode)`** — wraps `pkix-revocation::RevocationChecker` impls. Emits one `Finding` per cert per source (CRL or OCSP) with appropriate severity per `.4` decision.

Test surface:
- baseline: PKITS path-validation failures surface as `FindingSource::PathValidation` findings with the correct rule ID.
- revocation: revoked cert with HardFail → Invalid; revoked cert with SoftFail → Warn finding but Valid outcome; unreachable revocation source with SoftFail → Warn; with HardFail → Invalid.

**Blocks on:** .1 (trait), .4 (revocation granularity).
title: Implement policies::rfc5280_baseline + policies::revocation
